Name: Dr. Rei - Custom NPC
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[size=5][b]Dr. Rei - Custom NPC[/b][/size]
Meet Rei, the clinic's assistant while she trains to become a doctor. She's practical, a little tomboyish, and always ready to lend a hand—but put your feelings for her in writing or catch her off guard with a compliment, and that confident act falls apart fast. Get to know her through plenty of everyday, clinic, seasonal, festival, and married-life conversations.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54754]NPC Helper 2.2.0 or later[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]NPC Helper 2.2.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI and meet Rei in Pelican Town.[/*]
[/list]
Rei needs NPC Helper to appear in the game. If you need help, share your [url=https://smapi.io/log]full SMAPI log[/url] and the versions of both mods.

[size=4][b]Author[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TamKungZ]TamKungZ_[/url]
